## Problem and user workflow

What task is difficult today? Describe who benefits and give a concrete example.

## Proposed scope

Describe the smallest useful change, its interaction with existing commands or
reports, and any explicit exclusions from this issue.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replace this with an observable outcome.

## Dependencies and compatibility

Link prerequisite issues or related PRs. Describe effects on existing reports,
caches, manual decisions, and photo/sidecar handling where relevant.

## Validation

Describe logic tests, manual checks, or real-photo evaluation needed to establish
the result. For selection changes, state the baseline and how to measure keeper
recall, acceptable alternatives, and resource use. Do not commit private photos.
